title: Colombia Health Regulatory Expert (Consultant)
description:
ThinkWell is seeking a consultant who has experience in the Colombia health regulatory environment and can conduct the following work:

  • Map the laws, decrees, resolutions, and reforms underway relevant to the white paper, including Ley 2294 de 2023, the INVIMA reform bill, and the government’s deregulation agenda.
  • Conduct and document interviews with officials at INVIMA, MinSalud, and other institutions, and with health associations and gremios. About 10 interviews across two rounds.
  • Assess the legal feasibility of candidate reforms, and identify the right instrument and approval pathway for each.
  • Verify all legal references and institutional responsibilities in the draft and final white paper.
requirements:
• At least 10 years of experience in Colombian health law, regulation, or policy, with direct knowledge of INVIMA, MinSalud, and the legislative process.
  • Established relationships with government officials and sector associations.
  • Fluent Spanish and professional working English.
  • A law degree, or an advanced degree in health policy or a related field.
  • Any relationships with pharmaceutical, device, or insurance companies, EPS, or gremios must be disclosed.
